/**
 * 이미지의 고정 그림체.
 *
 * 중요:
 * - "book cover style"이라고 표현하지 않는다.
 * - 표지의 레이아웃이 아니라 표지 일러스트의 렌더링 미감만 지정한다.
 * - scenePrompt 안에서는 그림체를 다시 지정하지 않는 것을 권장한다.
 */
export const IMAGE_DEFAULT_ART_STYLE = [
  "Use the following only as the visual rendering style, never as a graphic-design layout:",
  "a premium Korean romance illustration aesthetic rendered as refined semi-realistic 2.5D digital art.",
  "Beautiful, elegant adult characters with harmonious facial proportions, expressive eyes, finely shaped lips, natural Korean features, and emotionally readable expressions.",
  "Smooth but realistic skin rendering, subtle subsurface warmth, delicate facial shading, individually defined hair strands, refined clothing textures, and clean anatomical proportions.",
  "Use soft gradient shading, polished highlights, gentle depth, luminous skin, restrained detail, and sophisticated warm-and-cool cinematic lighting.",
  "The result should feel glamorous, delicate, romantic, emotionally immersive, and professionally illustrated.",
  "Preserve the depth and lighting of a cinematic scene while remaining clearly illustrated rather than photographic.",
  "Do not imitate a live-action photograph, documentary frame, flat webtoon panel, cel-shaded anime frame, plastic 3D game render, oil painting, poster, or book-cover layout.",
].join(" ");


export const IMAGE_SCENE_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = [
  "Generate exactly one full-bleed cinematic narrative illustration from the supplied private story context.",
  "Depict one specific story moment visibly happening now, not a generic mood image or character pose.",
  "Show only the fictional world, characters, physical objects, lighting, expressions, body language, and visible action.",
  "Prioritize clearly readable faces, emotionally specific expressions, relationship dynamics, and story-relevant action.",
  "Use environmental details and character behavior to imply the immediately preceding story context.",
  "Apply the supplied visual-style instruction consistently to the entire image.",
  "Treat all style instructions strictly as rendering guidance, never as instructions to create a cover, poster, card, interface, or designed layout.",
  "Do not create a character introduction, character sheet, profile card, poster, title card, book cover, infographic, social-media post, chat screen, or any other graphic-design layout.",
  "Never render visible text of any kind, including names, biographies, titles, captions, labels, subtitles, speech bubbles, dialogue, letters, numbers, signs, logos, signatures, or watermarks in any language.",
  "If the context contains dialogue or written information, communicate its meaning only through composition, facial expression, body language, action, and environmental detail.",
].join(" ");


export const IMAGE_TEXT_NEGATIVE_PROMPT = [
  // 텍스트와 UI
  "text",
  "typography",
  "letters",
  "words",
  "numbers",
  "Hangul glyphs",
  "Latin alphabet glyphs",
  "kana glyphs",
  "kanji glyphs",
  "hanzi glyphs",
  "caption",
  "subtitle",
  "label",
  "speech bubble",
  "dialogue text",
  "signage",
  "logo",
  "signature",
  "watermark",
  "social media interface",
  "chat interface",

  // 디자인형 출력
  "character introduction",
  "character sheet",
  "profile card",
  "poster layout",
  "title card",
  "book cover layout",
  "graphic design layout",
  "decorative border",
  "split panel",
  "collage",

  // 원하지 않는 그림체
  "live-action photograph",
  "photorealistic photography",
  "documentary still",
  "flat webtoon line art",
  "flat cel shading",
  "children's anime style",
  "plastic 3D render",
  "video game character render",
  "oil painting",
  "rough sketch",

  // 자주 발생하는 품질 문제
  "underexposed face",
  "face hidden in shadow",
  "facial silhouette",
  "muddy shadows",
  "oversaturated orange lighting",
  "wax skin",
  "plastic skin",
  "distorted face",
  "asymmetrical eyes",
  "deformed hands",
  "extra fingers",
  "fused fingers",
  "extra limbs",
].join(", ");


export function applyImageScenePolicy(
  scenePrompt: string,
  artStyle: string = IMAGE_DEFAULT_ART_STYLE,
) {
  const normalizedScenePrompt = scenePrompt.trim();

  if (!normalizedScenePrompt) {
    throw new Error("scenePrompt must not be empty.");
  }

  return [
    "[VISUAL STYLE]",
    artStyle.trim(),

    "[SCENE FORMAT]",
    "Create exactly one continuous full-bleed cinematic narrative illustration.",
    "This must be a natural story scene, not a poster, cover, profile image, character showcase, or designed layout.",
    "Depict a specific story beat happening in this exact instant.",

    "[VISUAL PRIORITIES]",
    "Prioritize the characters' readable faces, precise expressions, eye contact, physical distance, body language, and story-relevant action.",
    "Keep the setting visibly recognizable but secondary to the emotional focus.",
    "Even in a dark nighttime setting, preserve clear facial detail and natural skin tones.",
    "Use cinematic composition and lighting without turning the image into live-action photography.",

    "[CURRENT STORY SCENE]",
    normalizedScenePrompt,
  ].join("\n\n");
}
